paired_rule: Two fresh-process A1/B1/A2/B2/A3 cohorts; all four pairs must pass. Baseline=sqrt(before*after); throughput gain=baseline/candidate-1; drift=after/before-1. No resampling or discarded retained samples.

issue.rule: FP16/BF16/INT8; 8 independent accumulator chains; local=2/8; iterations8192,reps9,4096 work-items. Two fresh-process A1/B1/A2/B2/A3 cohorts; A=DPAS,B=DPASW. Every numerical output must match CPU. Each of four candidate pairs must gain>=1%,absolute baseline drift<=3% for a shape to qualify. All samples retained. Frequency telemetry is diagnostic only.

lowbit.rule: u8s8 control; u4s8/u2s8/u4s4/u2s2 candidates. DPAS,8 independent chains,local2,4096 items,reps9. Equal operations: K32/8192 iterations or K64/4096 iterations. Two fresh-process A1/B1/A2/B2/A3 cohorts for each candidate. Every output checked against exact CPU before/after timing. Four pairs must each gain>=1%,abs baseline drift<=3%. Retain every sample. No application/quality/unlock claim or production adoption.
lowbit.analysis_note: Original runner completed all40 GPU processes, then failed while combining a string candidate label with the numeric candidate timing from paired(). This analysis renames only the label to precision. No GPU rerun, dropped sample or rule change.

hc.rule: Only N8 launch changes NSG8 to NSG1. Frozen production baseline and same FP32 arithmetic. Existing 256 HC and 1728 XMX boundary checks; every HC output hash must equal baseline. Two fresh A1/B1/A2/B2/A3 cohorts,13 T shapes,all timings retained. Each candidate pair requires absolute baseline drift<=3%; eligible shapes require>=1% throughput gain in all four pairs. No new model claim from operator timing.
hc.timing_unit: microseconds; each CASE is the existing seven-batch process median, not seven raw samples
hc.adoption: A770 only, BF16 N8 K10240 and T1024/2069 only, under existing native XMX opt-in. No full-model gain claim.
